description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different types of data within a dataset. There are three slices in the chart. The first slice, labeled "Null," is colored in light red and represents approximately 39.2% of the dataset. The second slice, labeled "Have reference answer," is colored in light blue and represents approximately 38.9% of the dataset. The third slice, labeled "Have test case," is colored in light green and represents approximately 21.9% of the dataset. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, which matches the colors of the slices to their corresponding labels. The percentages are displayed inside the slices, and the slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way. The chart does not appear to be ordered by size, and there is no indication of the total number of data points in the dataset.
